validity.recommendation: Keep the row (pipeline is real, no duplicate) but review PipelineType transmission -> gathering (low-pressure sour field-to-plant feeder), fix spelling 'Rumela' -> 'North Rumaila', and apply the status correction staged in status_reviews (operating since mid-2015, not construction/2025).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. The sheet's only citation (gem.wiki -> ahewar.org aid=757740, an Arabic translation of a Middle East mega-projects listicle; page is windows-1256 encoded) DOES describe this pipeline: Basra gas-gathering Phase 1 will capture/dry gas from compression stations at the West Qurna 1 & 2 fields and move it via a 40-inch, 50-km pipeline to the North Rumaila NGL plant, with an 8-inch condensate line alongside to a slug catcher; project 'suspended a long time, revived 2017, now expected complete in 2025'. Independently, Oil & Gas Journal (2016-03-07, 'Plant, pipeline reconfiguration boosts Iraqi NGL yield') documents the same physical line: 'BGC in 2012 resumed work on a partially completed 40-in. OD low-pressure gas pipeline from the West Qurna field to a new IBC station at the NR NGL plant. By mid-2015 this pipeline was operational and delivering 80 MMcfd of sour gas to the plant from DS-7 and DS-8' - the first-ever gas capture from West Qurna. Basrah Gas Company's own operations page confirms ongoing gathering from Rumaila, West Qurna 1 and Zubair into its NGL plants. CLASSIFICATION (the concern): this is a low-pressure SOUR associated-gas line from field degassing/compression stations (DS-7/DS-8) into an NGL processing plant - the textbook definition of a gathering/feed line, operated by Basrah Gas Company (South Gas Co 51% / Shell 44% / Mitsubishi 5%); GEM has PipelineType=transmission, controlled vocab has 'gathering'. Whether GGIT keeps low-pressure sour feeder lines is a scope call, hence concern rather than silent pass. STATUS/SPEC error exposed: GEM Status=construction + StartYear1=2025 is a misreading of the ahewar listicle - its '2025' completion refers to the overall revived Basra gas programme (FLNG etc.), while the 40-in line itself has been OPERATING since mid-2015 (OGJ); BGC and MEES (2025-10-24) confirm West Qurna-1 gas is being gathered/processed today; searched English + Arabic 2024-2026 and found NO new West Qurna->Rumaila line under construction (the only WQ-2 gas work is the SESM processing-facility contract of Nov 2023, not a pipeline). Staged as a status change in status_reviews. DUPLICATE check vs the 16-row roster: no match - P7459 Faiha-North Rumaila is a separate 20-in line from a different field, P4041 North Rumela-Al-Najaf runs the other direction (28-in), P7436/P7437 are the Artawi BNGL EPSCC lines (incl. the separate 13.7 km NR NGL feed); the 40-in/50-km WQ->NR line appears only once. ATTRIBUTION: Operator/Owner blank in GEM; sources support Basrah Gas Company - suggest staging on the OperatorsOwners tab. FuelSource 'Qurna' should ideally read 'West Qurna'. Length 50 km rests on the single ahewar listicle (OGJ gives no length) - kept, tier low.

50 km appears only in the ahewar listicle (the sheet's original source); OGJ confirms the pipeline but gives no length. West Qurna field to North Rumaila NGL plant is geographically consistent with ~50 km. Single weak aggregate source - tier low; no second independent length figure found in English or Arabic.

Carries sour associated natural gas (80 MMcfd initially per OGJ) from West Qurna degassing stations DS-7/DS-8 to the North Rumaila NGL plant; BGC operations page confirms associated-gas gathering from West Qurna 1. Commodity=gas is correct; note it is WET/SOUR gas feeding a processing plant, consistent with the gathering reclassification flagged in validity.

Gas source is the West Qurna (WQ-1) oil field - associated gas captured at degassing stations DS-7 and DS-8 (OGJ); BGC gathers from Rumaila, West Qurna 1 and Zubair. Suggest refining FuelSource 'Qurna' to 'West Qurna' for precision. The ahewar listicle says West Qurna 1 AND 2, but BGC's licence scope and OGJ cover WQ-1 only.

Deep-fill: StartLocation was blank - the line runs from the West Qurna field (DS-7/DS-8) to the North Rumaila NGL plant (OGJ; BGC). Both endpoints sit in Basra Governorate (BGC's Licensing Round-1 fields Rumaila / West Qurna 1 / Zubair are all in Basra province). EndLocation 'Rumela' should ideally read 'North Rumaila' (the NGL plant site).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: GEM has construction + StartYear1=2025, sourced only from the ahewar listicle whose '2025' completion date refers to the overall revived Basra gas-gathering programme, not this line. OGJ (2016-03-07) states BGC resumed work in 2012 on the partially completed 40-in West Qurna -> NR NGL line and 'by mid-2015 this pipeline was operational', delivering 80 MMcfd sour gas from DS-7/DS-8 - the first-ever gas capture from West Qurna. Current operation corroborated by two further independent sources: BGC's own operations page describes ongoing gathering from West Qurna 1 into its NGL plants, and MEES (2025-10-24) reports BGC currently collects/processes ~80% of associated gas from Rumaila, Zubair and West Qurna-1 (1.4 bn cfd processing capacity), targeting full capture by 2028. Searched English and Arabic (2024-2026) for any NEW West Qurna->Rumaila gas line under construction - none found; the only WQ-2 gas work is the SESM gas-processing-facility contract (Nov 2023), not this pipeline. Proposed: Status=operating (lowercase controlled vocab), StartYear1=2015 (mid-2015 per OGJ; month not staged). Status has been ~10 years stale.

summary: P6007 is real (BGC's 40-in West Qurna -> North Rumaila NGL sour-gas line) but wrongly recorded: operating since mid-2015, not construction/StartYear 2025 (GEM misread its single listicle source), and arguably PipelineType gathering rather than transmission; no roster duplicate; verified refs staged for diameter, length, fuel, fuel source, and location.
